newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Monsanto rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Monsanto rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it reaffirmed Monsanto Co's single-A-plus senior unsecured debt rating and D-one commercial paper rating.

The ratings were removed from rating watch-uncertain where they were placed after the initial announcement of Monsanto's plan to split the company in two by spinning off its chemicals business, Duff & Phelps said in a statement.

Ratings will be assigned for the new chemical spin-out at a later date, Duff & Phelps. The chemicals business is expected to be spun off September 1, 1997 with a capital structure aimed at attaining an investment grade rating.

The ratings are based on a strong cash-flow generating capacity of the life sciences business and assurances from management that normalized book debt-to-capitalization will be managed to the 35-40 percent range, it said.
Over the last decade, Monsanto has made significant acquisitions, divestitures and equity investments in an effort to reduce cyclicality and improve returns, it noted.
